# ARKhives 8.21.0

Study Mode adds Tiko using the complete supplied v2 character rig: expressive answer reactions, pointer and touch gaze, idle gestures, sound off by default, and reduced-motion controls. Choices animate into an explanation panel in place. The question and saved explanation share the main reading pane, while optional laureate insights retain their own pane.

ARKdaily adds a discovery feed on desktop and mobile with 2,276 fully transcribed source posts from 1,319 scanned pages: 2,272 interactive questions and four illustrated facts. Questions, choices and supplied explanations appear as readable text with matching diagrams and photos. Original question and answer scans remain accessible under Source. Five-label diagrams and explicitly accepted alternate keys are preserved. One conflicting printed answer letter is explained visibly; 289 source answers have no explanatory paragraph and say so instead of inventing one.

The feed also samples saved MCQ explanations and approved alternatives with their mapped images, plus famous-building, Philippine church and dictum flashcards. Scrolling, answering and revealing do not change official progress, mastery, due dates or FSRS. No AI generation is requested while browsing saved material.

Images load on demand from the published feed. Tiko is reused for the active post, and long feeds keep a bounded number of rendered cards. Daily saves are local to each device. Source references and report controls are included.

The previous desktop Overview asset packaging gap is fixed. The coordinated release checks cover both presentation surfaces, paired source media, learning isolation, native/WASM scheduling and recovery. Existing question banks, progress and notebooks are preserved. Browser testing does not substitute for physical-device testing.

The full OCR text, question photos and diagrams ship in the mobile site. Original answer scans retain their source quality in an immutable, checksum-verified content archive. This keeps both compressed and expanded mobile packages within hosting limits.
